import sys

def ccw(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy):
    # Cross product of (b-a) and (c-a)
    return (bx - ax) * (cy - ay) - (by - ay) * (cx - ax)

def on_segment(ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy):
    # Check if point c lies on segment ab (collinear and within bounding box)
    return (min(ax, bx) <= cx <= max(ax, bx) and
            min(ay, by) <= cy <= max(ay, by))

def intersect(p0, p1, p2, p3):
    x0, y0 = p0
    x1, y1 = p1
    x2, y2 = p2
    x3, y3 = p3

    o1 = ccw(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2)
    o2 = ccw(x0, y0, x1, y1, x3, y3)
    o3 = ccw(x2, y2, x3, y3, x0, y0)
    o4 = ccw(x2, y2, x3, y3, x1, y1)

    # General case
    if o1 * o2 < 0 and o3 * o4 < 0:
        return True

    # Collinear cases
    if o1 == 0 and on_segment(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        return True
    if o2 == 0 and on_segment(x0, y0, x1, y1, x3, y3):
        return True
    if o3 == 0 and on_segment(x2, y2, x3, y3, x0, y0):
        return True
    if o4 == 0 and on_segment(x2, y2, x3, y3, x1, y1):
        return True

    return False

import sys

def cross(ax, ay, bx, by):
    return ax * by - ay * bx

def orient(a, b, c):
    return cross(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1])

def on_segment(a, b, p):
    return (min(a[0], b[0]) <= p[0] <= max(a[0], b[0]) and
            min(a[1], b[1]) <= p[1] <= max(a[1], b[1]))

def segments_intersect(p0, p1, p2, p3):
    o1 = orient(p0, p1, p2)
    o2 = orient(p0, p1, p3)
    o3 = orient(p2, p3, p0)
    o4 = orient(p2, p3, p1)

    # General case
    if ((o1 > 0 and o2 < 0) or (o1 < 0 and o2 > 0)) and \
       ((o3 > 0 and o4 < 0) or (o3 < 0 and o4 > 0)):
        return True

    # Collinear / touching cases
    if o1 == 0 and on_segment(p0, p1, p2):
        return True
    if o2 == 0 and on_segment(p0, p1, p3):
        return True
    if o3 == 0 and on_segment(p2, p3, p0):
        return True
    if o4 == 0 and on_segment(p2, p3, p1):
        return True

    return False
